mapper.sql: SELECT u.id as u_id, u.username as u_username, u.nickname as u_nickname, u.password as u_password, u.email as u_email, u.avatar as u_avatar, u.status as u_status, u.session_version as u_session_version, u.created_at as u_created_at, u.updated_at as u_updated_at, r.id as r_id, r.name as r_name, r.code as r_code, r.description as r_description, r.status as r_status, r.level as r_level, r.landing_page as r_landing_page, r.created_at as r_created_at, r.updated_at as r_updated_at FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
